def: properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs

occurrences.text: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the Lord might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
